mapper.sql: COALESCE((SELECT MAX(e.episode_no) FROM 0721acgn.tb_animation_episode e WHERE e.animation_id = work.id AND e.video_url IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(e.video_url) != ''), 0)

COALESCE((SELECT MAX(c.chapterno) FROM 0721acgn.tb_cartoonchapters c WHERE c.comicid = work.comicid AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM 0721acgn.tb_cartoonpage p WHERE p.chapterid = c.chapterid AND p.fileurl IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(p.fileurl) != '' )), 0)
COALESCE((SELECT MAX(n.chapterno) FROM 0721acgn.tb_novelchapter n WHERE n.novelid = work.novelid AND n.novelurl IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(n.novelurl) != ''), 0)

sql.if: AND LENGTH(TRIM(IFNULL(releasedate,''))) >= 4 AND CAST(LEFT(TRIM(releasedate), 4) AS UNSIGNED) >= #{yearMin}
AND LENGTH(TRIM(IFNULL(releasedate,''))) >= 4 AND CAST(LEFT(TRIM(releasedate), 4) AS UNSIGNED) <= #{yearMax}

mapper.select: SELECT '漫画' AS sourcetype, comicid AS id, name, picurl AS picurl, rating, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM 0721acgn.tb_cartoons WHERE name LIKE CONCAT('%', TRIM(#{search}), '%') UNION ALL SELECT '动漫' AS sourcetype, id, name, bcimg AS picurl, rating, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM 0721acgn.tb_animation WHERE name LIKE CONCAT('%', TRIM(#{search}), '%') UNION ALL SELECT '轻小说' AS sourcetype, novelid AS id, name, picurl AS picurl, rating, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM 0721acgn.tb_novel WHERE name LIKE CONCAT('%', TRIM(#{search}), '%') ORDER BY sourcetype, id;

SELECT id, name_zh AS name, cover AS picurl, 'Galgame' AS sourcetype, rating, updated_at AS updatedAt, CASE WHEN name_zh = #{search} OR name_original = #{search} THEN 0 WHEN LOCATE(#{search}, name_zh) = 1 OR LOCATE(#{search}, name_original) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS matchRank FROM 0721acgn.tb_galgame
(LOCATE(#{search}, name_zh) > 0 OR LOCATE(#{search}, name_original) > 0 OR LOCATE(#{search}, aliases) > 0)
AND LOCATE(#{genre}, genres) > 0 AND release_year >= #{yearMin} AND release_year <= #{yearMax}
ORDER BY matchRank, id

SELECT id, name, avatarurl AS picurl, '角色' AS sourcetype FROM 0721acgn.tb_acgnuser WHERE id REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' AND CAST(id AS UNSIGNED) > 0 AND TRIM(name) != '' AND LOCATE(#{search}, name) > 0 ORDER BY (name = #{search}) DESC, (LOCATE(#{search}, name) = 1) DESC, CAST(id AS UNSIGNED) LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT '漫画' AS sourcetype, comicid AS id, name, picurl AS picurl, rating, updated_at AS updatedAt, AS resourceEnd FROM 0721acgn.tb_cartoons work
LIMIT 220

SELECT '动漫' AS sourcetype, id, name, bcimg AS picurl, rating, updated_at AS updatedAt, AS resourceEnd FROM 0721acgn.tb_animation work
LIMIT 220

SELECT '轻小说' AS sourcetype, novelid AS id, name, picurl AS picurl, rating, updated_at AS updatedAt, AS resourceEnd FROM 0721acgn.tb_novel work
LIMIT 220
